title: "Gallery: chat & AI kit"
description: >
  The streaming-transcript primitives – bubbles, messages, attachments,
  markers and the stick-to-bottom scroller – rendered live with their source.
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
for (p in c("_common.R", "../_common.R", "vignettes/_common.R"))
  if (file.exists(p)) { source(p); break }
```

The chat kit is a small set of composable pieces for building assistant and
messaging UIs: **bubbles** carry text, **messages** wrap a bubble with an avatar
and metadata, **attachments** show files, **markers** annotate the stream, and
the **scroller** keeps a growing transcript pinned to the bottom. The
[support-chat example](https://github.com/orijitghosh/shadshiny/tree/main/inst/examples/03-support-chat)
wires them into a working inbox.

## Bubble

The atom of a conversation. `variant` sets the surface; `align` places it
left (received) or right (sent).

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE, {
  shad_bubble("Hey! Are we still on for 3pm?", align = "start")
  shad_bubble("Absolutely – see you then.", variant = "tinted", align = "end")
})
```

## Message

A bubble with an avatar, sender name and timestamp. Group consecutive turns with
`shad_message_group()`.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_message_group(
    shad_message(
      shad_bubble("Can you summarise the Q3 report?"),
      align = "start", avatar = shad_avatar(fallback = "You"), sender = "You",
      meta = "9:41 AM"
    ),
    shad_message(
      shad_bubble("Revenue rose 12% to $4.2M, driven by the new tier."),
      align = "start", avatar = shad_avatar(fallback = "AI"),
      sender = "Assistant", meta = "9:41 AM"
    )
  )
)
```

## Typing indicator

`shad_message_spinner()` is the animated three-dot "typing…" bubble, shown while
a reply streams in.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_message(
    shad_message_spinner(),
    align = "start", avatar = shad_avatar(fallback = "AI"), sender = "Assistant"
  )
)
```

## Marker

A slim inline annotation for the stream – a date break, a "streaming…" cue, or a
status note.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_marker("Today", icon = "calendar")
  shad_marker("Generating response", icon = "loader", streaming = TRUE)
})
```

## Attachment

A file card with title, size, a media thumbnail slot and actions. Group several
with `shad_attachment_group()`.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_attachment_group(
    shad_attachment(
      title = "quarterly-report.pdf", description = "2.4 MB",
      media = "file", media_variant = "icon",
      actions = shad_attachment_action(icon = "arrow-right", aria_label = "Download")
    ),
    shad_attachment(
      title = "budget.xlsx", description = "845 KB · uploading",
      media = "file", media_variant = "icon", state = "uploading"
    )
  )
)
```

## Message scroller

`shad_message_scroller()` is a fixed-height transcript that sticks to the bottom
as content arrives, with a "jump to latest" affordance. Append to it and pin it
from the server with `shad_message_scroller_to_bottom()`.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_message_scroller(
    "demo_scroller", height = "16rem", auto_scroll = TRUE,
    shad_message_scroller_item(
      shad_message(shad_bubble("Welcome to support – how can I help?"),
        align = "start", avatar = shad_avatar(fallback = "AI"), sender = "Assistant")
    ),
    shad_message_scroller_item(
      shad_message(shad_bubble("My invoice looks wrong.", variant = "tinted"),
        align = "end", avatar = shad_avatar(fallback = "You"), sender = "You")
    ),
    shad_message_scroller_item(
      shad_message(shad_bubble("I can help with that. What's the invoice number?"),
        align = "start", avatar = shad_avatar(fallback = "AI"), sender = "Assistant")
    )
  )
)
```
